newsHighlights.title: Shenzhen: A gateway to openness
newsHighlights.summary: From a fishing village to a hub of innovation, Shenzhen's remarkable transformation reflects China's extraordinary journey of reform and opening-up as the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting approaches.
newsHighlights.translation: 从一个渔村发展成为创新高地，深圳的非凡蜕变映照出中国改革开放的伟大征程，第33次亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议即将在此举行。

newsHighlights.title: 'Miracle' metropolis now a global magnet
newsHighlights.summary: Shenzhen, once a small border town, has become a miracle metropolis that attracts entrepreneurs, researchers and travelers from around the world.
newsHighlights.translation: 深圳，这座昔日的边陲小镇，如今已成为吸引全球创业者、科研人员与旅行者的奇迹之城。

newsHighlights.title: Former UNESCO chief: High expectations for APEC Shenzhen
newsHighlights.summary: A former UNESCO chief voiced high expectations for the APEC meetings in Shenzhen, praising the city's openness, cultural vitality and hospitality.
newsHighlights.translation: 联合国教科文组织前总干事对深圳APEC会议寄予厚望，称赞这座城市的开放、文化活力与待客之道。

newsHighlights.title: What APEC has to do with your fruit plate
newsHighlights.summary: Trade deals struck at APEC lower tariffs on fresh produce, which is why tropical fruit from Asia-Pacific economies ends up on your plate at a lower price.
newsHighlights.translation: 亚太经合组织达成的贸易协定降低了生鲜农产品的关税，这正是亚太经济体的热带水果能以更低价出现在你餐桌上的原因。

newsHighlights.title: China initiates steps to explore the Jupiter system
newsHighlights.summary: The China National Space Administration has begun concrete preparations for Tianwen 4, an ambitious interplanetary expedition to explore the Jovian system.
newsHighlights.translation: 国家航天局已着手为天问四号开展实际筹备工作，这项雄心勃勃的行星际远征将探测木星系统。

quote.quote: The world is a book and those who do not travel read only one page.
quote.author: Saint Augustine
quote.translation: 世界是一本书，不旅行的人只读了其中的一页。
quote.explanation: 这句名言把世界比作一本书，鼓励人们走出熟悉的地方去见识不同的文化与风景。正如深圳从渔村走向世界舞台、APEC把整个亚太的旅客与商人汇聚一堂，旅行与交流能开阔眼界、丰富人生。

vocabulary.example: Shenzhen has become a gateway to openness for the whole country.
vocabulary.translation: 深圳已成为全国对外开放的门户。
vocabulary.newsContext: 新闻标题“Shenzhen: A gateway to openness”中，用gateway比喻深圳是连接中国与世界的窗口。

vocabulary.example: Shenzhen's remarkable transformation reflects China's journey of reform and opening-up.
vocabulary.translation: 深圳的非凡蜕变折射出中国的改革开放历程。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻“Shenzhen: A gateway to openness”中“Shenzhen's remarkable transformation reflects...”。

vocabulary.example: The 'miracle' metropolis now draws visitors and investors from every continent.
vocabulary.translation: 这座“奇迹”大都市如今吸引着各大洲的游客与投资者。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻“'Miracle' metropolis now a global magnet”，描述深圳从小城发展为国际都市。

vocabulary.definition: 磁铁；有吸引力的人或事物
vocabulary.example: Shenzhen has become a global magnet for talent, technology and trade.
vocabulary.translation: 深圳已成为吸引人才、技术和贸易的全球磁石。
vocabulary.newsContext: 新闻标题“'Miracle' metropolis now a global magnet”用magnet比喻深圳强大的吸引力。

vocabulary.example: From a fishing village to a hub of innovation, Shenzhen has amazed the world.
vocabulary.translation: 从渔村到创新高地，深圳令世界惊叹。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻“Shenzhen: A gateway to openness”中的“a hub of innovation”。

vocabulary.example: Tianwen 4 is one of China's most ambitious interplanetary expeditions.
vocabulary.translation: 天问四号是中国最具雄心的行星际远征任务之一。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻“China initiates steps to explore the Jupiter system”中的“ambitious interplanetary expeditions”。

vocabulary.definition: 遗产；遗志；留给后世的影响
vocabulary.example: People gathered to carry on Sun Yat-sen's legacy of national rejuvenation.
vocabulary.translation: 人们齐聚一堂，传承孙中山先生振兴中华的遗志。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻“Xi calls for unity to carry on Sun Yat-sen's legacy”。

vocabulary.example: The Microsoft outage was a lesson on data sovereignty for every country.
vocabulary.translation: 微软这次宕机事件给各国上了一堂关于数据主权的课。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自CGTN新闻“The Microsoft outage China barely felt: A lesson on data sovereignty”。

vocabulary.example: The Asia-Pacific region needs inclusive digital supply chains, not digital fences.
vocabulary.translation: 亚太地区需要包容的数字供应链，而不是“数字围栏”。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻“Asia-Pacific needs digital bridges, not 'digital fences'”中的“inclusive digital supply chain finance”。

vocabulary.example: Shenzhen's remarkable transformation has made it a magnet for travelers.
vocabulary.translation: 深圳的非凡蜕变使其成为旅行者向往之地。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻“Shenzhen: A gateway to openness”中的“Shenzhen's remarkable transformation”。

pattern.example: From a fishing village to a hub of innovation, Shenzhen's remarkable transformation reflects China's extraordinary journey of reform and opening-up.
pattern.translation: 从一个渔村到创新高地，深圳的非凡蜕变映照出中国改革开放的伟大征程。
pattern.usage: 该句型用 From... to... 置于句首，对比前后两个阶段，突出巨大变化；逗号后接主句说明结果或意义。常用于描述城市发展、职业转变、旅行经历等。如：From a quiet county to a popular travel destination, the town has changed beyond recognition.

grammar.title: as 引导的时间状语从句（表“随着……”）
grammar.explanation: as 可以引导时间状语从句，表示两个动作或状态同时发生或同步变化，常译为“随着……”“当……的时候”。当主从句谓语都是延续性动词时，用 as 强调“同步发展”的过程；主从句时态通常一致，常用一般现在时表将来安排，或用一般过去时叙述过去的变化。
examples: As the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting approaches, Shenzhen is preparing to welcome guests from across the Asia-Pacific.
As the city opened up to the world, it grew from a fishing village into a global metropolis.

pronunciation.tips: 这是四音节词，重音在第三个音节 -ma- 上：trans-for-MA-tion。中间的 -for- 弱读为 /fə/，不要读成 /fɔː/；结尾 -tion 统一读 /ʃn/，注意舌尖抵住上齿龈，气流从舌侧送出，不要读成“提昂”。整词语调在重音处上扬后自然下降。
examples: Shenzhen's transformation from a fishing village to a metropolis took just over forty years.
Digital technology is driving a rapid transformation in the way people travel.

reading.title: Shenzhen: From Fishing Village to Global Travel Magnet
reading.content: Just over forty years ago, Shenzhen was a quiet fishing village near the Hong Kong border. Today it is a bustling metropolis of skyscrapers, museums and designer hotels, welcoming millions of business travelers and tourists each year. As the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting approaches, the city is preparing to show the world its remarkable transformation. Visitors can walk from modern art galleries in the Futian district to ancient Hakka villages in the suburbs, experiencing both innovation and tradition in a single day. Local officials describe Shenzhen as a gateway to openness, linking China with the entire Asia-Pacific region. The city's visa convenience, high-speed rail and direct flights make it an easy first stop for international visitors. From a fishing village to a hub of innovation, Shenzhen proves that travel is not only about sightseeing — it is about witnessing history in the making.
reading.translation: 就在四十多年前，深圳还是香港边境附近一个安静的渔村。如今，它已是一座摩天大楼、博物馆和设计酒店林立的繁华都市，每年迎接数百万商务旅客与游客。随着第33次亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议临近，这座城市正准备向世界展示其非凡的蜕变。游客可以在福田的现代艺术馆与郊外的古老客家村落之间漫步，在一天之内同时感受创新与传统。当地官员把深圳称为对外开放的门户，连接着中国与整个亚太地区。便利的签证政策、高铁与直飞航班，使其成为国际游客理想的第一站。从渔村到创新高地，深圳证明了旅行不只是观光——更是见证历史的发生。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 ChinaDaily《Shenzhen: A gateway to openness》《'Miracle' metropolis now a global magnet》及《Former UNESCO chief: High expectations for APEC Shenzhen》等今日新闻改写，为英语学习目的进行了语言简化与拓展。
